cells.gaps: No source found says a facility with GPUs or AI accelerators is in service in Sierra Leone. DSTI's Kuma models are prototypes below production quality, and no source says Africell's AI-EVA was built in the country.
cells.note: Fact 2026-11-26: DSTI's Kuma project has built initial Krio and Mende text-to-speech prototypes, an initial Sierra Leonean language model and a working speech-to-text pipeline, shown in a public playground (SLE-006, May 2025): a model built in the country and released. No AI computing in the country is found, so 3.
